name: Crouch cancel
goal: Crouch through an attack as you come in, and punish it before the attacker can act
why: A hit taken crouching has two thirds of its knockback, and with the stick held down {char} is back on the floor as its freeze ends, while the attacker is still in its move. Coming into an opponent's reach crouching turns its attack into {char}'s punish. How much damage that holds to depends on the attack: past it, the hit knocks {char} down all the same.

tutorial.what: Come into the opponent's reach and hold the stick down before it attacks. Keep it down through the hit's freeze: {char} stays on the floor. Then the C-stick down, A or Z.
tutorial.expect: The opponent moves about and attacks when {char} comes in, or comes in itself: another opponent, attack and damage every try. A try begins when its attack hits and is judged when {char}'s punish lands or the opponent can act again: whether {char} was crouching, stayed on the floor, and punished.

marks.1: Frame 1: {opp}'s {move} hits {char} at {PERCENT}%, crouching. The freeze

lessons.title: Crouch cancel
text: A hit taken crouching has two thirds of its knockback, and freezes {char} two thirds as long.
With the stick still down when the freeze ends, {char} stays on the floor, or is put back on it at once. Taken standing, the same hit sends {char} away in hitstun.

lessons.title: Coming in
text: {opp} keeps its distance and attacks when {char} comes into its reach, at once or after a moment; sometimes it comes in itself. There is no time to see the attack and crouch: the stick goes down as {char} arrives, before it.
A walk stops into a crouch at once. A dash does not: let go of the stick first.

marks.1: Frame 1: {opp}'s {move} hits {char} at {PERCENT}%, crouching. The freeze

lessons.title: How much damage
text: Knockback grows with damage, and every attack has its own. Measured, {char} stays on its feet through {opp}'s {move} up to {HOLD}%; a jab holds far longer than a smash.
Here every try begins at a damage the crouch still holds at and a punish still lands at: the more damage, the farther the hit pushes {char} and the longer it takes to act.

marks.1: Frame 1: {opp}'s {move} hits {char} at {PERCENT}%, crouching. The freeze

lessons.title: The punish
text: The attacker is still in its move when {char} can act again, a few frames after the freeze.
The C-stick down is a down smash, A with the stick still down a down tilt, Z a grab. Which reaches depends on where the attack left the attacker: a dash attack often ends on top of {char}, or past.

marks.1: Frame 1: {opp}'s {move} hits {char} at {PERCENT}%, crouching. The freeze

lessons.title: On the floor
text: An opponent that misses its tech lies on the floor until it chooses how to get up. Its getup attack hits on both sides, but weakly.
Standing over it crouching covers that choice: the attack is crouch cancelled, and it is open for as long as the attack lasts. It pushes {char} back a little: the punish has to reach.

marks.1: Frame 1: {opp}'s {move} hits {char} at {PERCENT}%, crouching. The freeze

lessons.title: Where it stops
text: Once two thirds of the knockback still sends {char} tumbling, crouching no longer holds: {char} is knocked down.
Here, at {PERCENT}%, {opp}'s {move} does that. From there on the answer is the shield, or staying out of reach.

attempt.missed: Not counted: {opp} did not hit {char}. Come into its reach and crouch.

crouched.headline: Not crouching
crouched.fix: Hold the stick down before the hit lands: as {char} comes into its reach, not when the attack is seen. Out of a dash, let go of the stick first.

grounded.expect: On the floor when the freeze ended
grounded.words: in the air for {air_frames} after the freeze
grounded.headline: Lifted off the floor
grounded.fix: Keep the stick down until the freeze is over. The game reads it on the freeze's last frame and puts {char} back on the floor.

punished.expect: A hit or a grab before it can act again
punished.words: {opp} could act again before the punish
punished.headline: No punish
punished.fix: {char} can act a few frames after the freeze. Then, at once: the C-stick down, A with the stick still down, or Z, whichever reaches where its {move} left it.

standing.headline: Knocked down
standing.fix: At this damage its {move} knocks a crouching {char} down. Shield it, or stay out of its reach.
